plan_name: Sample controlled failback to recovered primary site
stop_conditions: Reverse replication is unhealthy or its lag exceeds the approved threshold.
The authoritative write location or reconciliation outcome is unclear.
The target site fails application or data validation before traffic cutover.
The rollback path or business approval is withdrawn.

steps.name: Confirm source/target roles, change and ownership
Enable reverse protection towards the original site
Verify replication convergence and approved recovery point
Quiesce writes and reconcile data according to the runbook
Execute approved planned cutover and redirect traffic
Validate service health, transactions and business acceptance
Re-establish protection in the new primary direction
